detail:
The Astra Samui is a new resort-style condominium in Bophut, on Koh Samui's north coast. With 237 residences across three low-rise buildings, it is one of the largest condominium projects the island has seen, and it is the first Samui project from Ornsirin Holding PCL. Ornsirin is one of the largest Thai developers, with more than 20 projects since 2006. Its condominium brands include The Next, Arise and The Astra, with Chiang Mai buildings of more than 500 residences. In Phuket, its Arise Vibe condominium of 411 residences set a sales record for the company in pre-sale. Ornsirin has also won Best Developer and Best Condominium Interior Design at the Dot Property Awards.

The buildings rise four storeys above a basement and wrap around a long lagoon pool threaded through tropical gardens. The architecture takes its cues from Samui itself, with hipped roofs, timber slats and warm, natural materials. Selected ground-floor residences step straight from the terrace into the pool. Residents share a lobby, fitness centre and sauna, with parking for around 42% of units.

The location is the draw. Bophut Beach is about 300 m away and Fisherman's Village, with its restaurants, cafés and bars, about 850 m. Big C is 2.4 km away, the International School Samui 3.3 km and the airport 7.3 km. Foreign freehold is offered within the building's foreign quota, so an overseas buyer can own the unit outright in their own name. That is rare at this price this close to the beach. Leasehold is offered on the remaining units.
